verdict.rationale: LangGraph is driven through a documented public API. The Python Graph API covers State, Nodes, Edges and compile-time runtime args, plus stream/astream with multiple stream modes and resuming via Command. The CLI-built Agent Server also exposes API endpoints for runs, threads and assistants. However, the probe found no OpenAPI spec at the standard docs paths, and the server endpoints are only described at a high level. missing for 10: a published machine-readable OpenAPI/endpoint reference for the Agent Server, detailed endpoint documentation, independent hands-on corroboration of driving the server API in production.
